accounting_contract.model_event_counting: each legal admission transfer is charged once on the path that executes it

accounting_contract.common_cost_cancellation: allowed only after isolated paths produce equal lifecycle events
accounting_contract.network_scope: modeled from frozen Mbps and fixed latency; never reported as measured wall time
accounting_contract.decision_score_separation: online methods use detached previews and estimates; offline reference alone uses realized branch scores

original_simple_threshold.lifecycle_handling: ignored simple baseline; cancellation is interpreted only after event equality audit

eviction_aware_recovery.information_scope: initial residents, declared current/next dependencies, legal native previews, ex-ante estimates

two_step_lookahead.rule: explicitly compare restart-current-next and recover-current-next ledgers without realized scores

offline_reference.future_information_advantage: selects after two isolated legal native paths are scored

design_source.classification: corrected replay of the original development matrix, not independent validation
design_source.unchanged: all 12 instance definitions, order, cache capacities, workflow adapters, residents, cost parameters and estimate multipliers are inherited byte-identified from v1
